PLAN "12-Week Postpartum Return Programme (home, light activity)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Postpartum gentle reconditioning with core-protective progression"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Mobility and light cardio start":
        warmup:
          walking 0..0 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          standing_pelvic_floor_activation 2x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Gentle loaded breath and mobility":
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bodyweight_squat_assisted 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          wall_push_up_child_pose_variant 2x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thread_the_needles_pose 3 minutes
      DAY Friday training 25m "Core-protection and posture":
        warmup:
          march_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hooklying_bridging_with_iab 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug_restricted 2x6 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child's_pose 3 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks) continued:
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 28m "Progression and breathing":
        warmup:
          gentle_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          side_limb_lift_supported 2x6 each side rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_opening_seq 4 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 28m "Posture and rib flare prevention":
        warmup:
          neck_stretches 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          wall_squat_assisted 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          scapular_retraction_hold 3x10 seconds rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose_with_breath 4 minutes
      DAY Friday training 28m "Gentle hips and core activation":
        warmup:
          ankle_marches 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge_single_leg_assist 2x8 each side rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug_modified 3x6 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          kneeling_cat_cow 4 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks) completed
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Controlled loading begins":
        warmup:
          walking_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          chair_property_laterals 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          incline_wall_push_up 3x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thread_the_needles_pose 4 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Continue core-friendly loading":
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hip_band_squats_with_support 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog_knee_down 3x6 each side rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine_knee_to_chest 4 minutes
      DAY Friday training 35m "Lower body with stability focus":
        warmup:
          march_in_place 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge_progressive 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          wall_push_up_progress 3x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose_with_breath 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks) continued:
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 38m "Add light total-body control":
        warmup:
          light jog substitute 0 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          step_up_down_low_step 3x6 each leg rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          incline_row_like 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_foam_roll 4 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 38m "Core-friendly progression":
        warmup:
          rib_cage_expansion 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug_bilateral 3x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          half_kneeling_counter_mlex 3x6 each side rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow_series 4 minutes
      DAY Friday training 38m "Mobility and basic strength":
        warmup:
          leg_swings_front_back 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          chair_assisted_split_squat 3x6 each side rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          wall_press_up 3x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child's_pose_hold 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks) completed
  PHASE "Phase 3 / Final Phase" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Return to activity with moderate load":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bodyweight_forward_lolds 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          incline_push_up_with_elevation 3x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          yoga_child_pose_and_breath 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Stability and light resistance":
        warmup:
          hip circles 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge_marching 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          resistance_band_good_m mornings 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch_series 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 40m "Full-body control and breath":
        warmup:
          thoracic_openers 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          step_up_with_control 3x8 each leg rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          incline_row_like_2 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          seated_breathing_5_minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3 / Final Phase" (4 weeks) completed

SYNTAX RULES:
- Rep ranges use TWO dots, not a dash. Correct: 3x8..12. 
- Sets always come first: 3x10 means 3 sets of 10 reps.
- RPE goes after sets/reps: 3x8..12 rpe 5.
- Rest in seconds: rest 60 seconds.

Notes:
- All exercises are chosen to be safe for light activity postpartum, no abdominal crunches, no heavy lifting, and no supine activities beyond gentle bridging as cleared.
- Modify or skip any exercise that causes discomfort and consult clinician if red flags appear.
- Volume is intentionally conservative and gradually progresses across phases.
- All plans assume home environment with a yoga mat; no equipment beyond bodyweight and light resistance bands if available.
